page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. The left margin is cut off by the gutter, so the notes are fragments. No footnotes, catchword or signature are visible.

main_text.p: probro, & infamiâ illius falsum repudii prætextum consultò quærere: omnis honestatis, pudorisq; expertem, imò in malitiæ & perfidiæ fastigium projectum hominem arguit.

Di[?]Sed quoniam tanta, tamque deplorata & incorrigibilis fuit populi Judaici malitia, permisit ipsis Deus potius proprios liberos vedere, quàm ut duro egestatis telo, & fame malesuadâ compulsi, furta, aut alia graviora designarent peccata: uxores itedem displicentes repudiare, ut miserè & iniquè oppressæ, ex pistrino tam gravi semel liberarentur, quibus satius fuit, semel dimitti liberas, quàm tota vitâ sub crudeli tyrannide gemere, imò in continuo vitæ periculo trepidare. Et atth. 19. v. 8.quia aliquando accidit, ut libidinosis & avaris viris uxorum fastidium & naufea obrepat, illiqué deinde quidvis comminiscantur, ut ab uxoribus sese expediant: necesse fuit vitium hoc corrigi, modumq; præscribi, quo tuta tandem esset uxorum integritas & salus, contra injurias & calumnias quotidianas crudelium & iniquorum maritorum. Item ne zelotypiæ affectus furiosus dissidia generaret inextricabilia, & animum mariti ab uxore alienando, amoris & fidei conjugalis vinculum tandem rumperet, multisq; adeò malis & sceleribus januam aperiret; Deus per zelotypiæ potum, occultæ uxorum fraudis cognitionem suscepit, seque castitatis conjugalis custodem professus est. Noluit etiam, ut novi conjuges per militiam statim divellerentur, ne nuper sese mutuò experti, antequam probè sibi invicem adsuevissent, eò procliviores ad peregrinos

page.notes: The left margin is cropped by the book gutter. Its notes are only partly visible and are transcribed as fragments with [?]; words that are cut off are not reconstructed. Only the start of the first margin note is clearly legible. The note beside "atth. 19. v. 8." is a Scripture reference. The page's left-margin notes continue down the full height of the page, and most of them are unreadable. The text of the main column is clear and was transcribed letter by letter. The running head is printed as "mutabilibus." on the left and "CAPUT IX." in the centre.
